definitions.explanation: A school or educational program that holds classes in the evening, allowing students who work during the day to attend.

examples.japanese: {夜間学校|やかんがっこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|かよ}い→通う：01217_kayou⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦{働|はたら}いている→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: I work while attending night school.

examples.japanese: ⟦{高校|こうこう}→高校：01083_koukou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{卒業|そつぎょう}→卒業：01643_sotsugyou⟧⟦できなかった→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{夜間学校|やかんがっこう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{学|まな}び{直|なお}すことにした。
examples.english: Since I didn't graduate from high school, I decided to go back and study at night school.

examples.japanese: ⟦{戦後|せんご}→戦後：12853_sengo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{経済的|けいざいてき}→経済的：05675_keizaiteki⟧な⟦{理由|りゆう}→理由：01102_riyuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{昼間|ひるま}→昼間：01713_hiruma⟧⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|かよ}えない→通う：01217_kayou⟧⟦{若者|わかもの}→若者：03037_wakamono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、{夜間学校|やかんがっこう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{重要|じゅうよう}→重要：01575_juuyou⟧な⟦{役割|やくわり}→役割：03638_yakuwari⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{果|は}たした→果たす：10060_hatasu⟧。
examples.english: In the postwar period, night schools played an important role for young people who couldn't attend school during the day for economic reasons.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{夜間|やかん}→夜間：04133_yakan⟧ (nighttime/evening) and ⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧ (school). In Japan, {夜間学校|やかんがっこう} can refer to ⟦{定時制|ていじせい}→定時制：19786_teijisei⟧⟦{高校|こうこう}→高校：01083_koukou⟧ (part-time high schools with evening classes) or ⟦{夜間|やかん}→夜間：04133_yakan⟧⟦{中学校|ちゅうがっこう}→中学校：01465_chuugakkou⟧ (evening middle schools for adults who missed compulsory education). Night schools have historically served working youth and, more recently, foreign residents and elderly people.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {夜間学校|やかんがっこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|かよ}う→通う：01217_kayou⟧ — to attend night school
- {夜間学校|やかんがっこう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{学|まな}ぶ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧ — to study at night school
- {夜間学校|やかんがっこう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生徒|せいと}→生徒：01051_seito⟧ — night school students

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{定時制|ていじせい}→定時制：19786_teijisei⟧ — part-time school system (official term for evening high school programs)
- {夜学|やがく} — night school (shorter, slightly more colloquial synonym)
- ⟦{全日制|ぜんにちせい}→全日制：27057_zennichisei⟧ — full-time school system (the opposite: daytime classes)
